subdomain.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Processing
subdomain.capability: Continuous high-throughput ingestion of raw 1Hz sensor telemetry, physical boundary validation, chronological reconciliation of late packets, and append-only auditable storage for streaming analytics.
subdomain.why_distinct: Own rules (sensor metric boundaries, 60-second reorder window, append-only revisions) and own vocabulary distinct from downstream athletic analytics; stated as the platform's core domain component (PulseStream Engine).

ubiquitous_language.definition: Individual 1Hz data point (heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke).
Unit of transmission received from a device, carrying one or more Telemetry Samples.
Physical physiological/mechanical limits a sample value must satisfy.
Demand-driven flow control that lets the entry point absorb bursts without blocking.
Epoch time generated by the device; authoritative for ordering.
Arrival time at the engine; not used for ordering.
60-second tolerance within which delayed samples are re-indexed chronologically.
Appended record representing a corrective or backfilled version of a sample; prior records are never modified.

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Intake
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Accept ingress packets under backpressure and validate each sample against sensor metric boundaries.
invariants: Every sample is validated against its Sensor Metric Boundary (HR 30-240 BPM, Power 0-2500 W, Cadence 0-220 RPM, Swim pace >45 s/100m) before downstream propagation
Invalid samples are flagged VALIDATION_FAILED and never dropped
Ingestion entry point is non-blocking and backpressure-controlled

bounded_contexts.name: Chronology Reconciliation
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Order samples by device timestamp and reconcile out-of-order arrivals within the reorder window.
invariants: Samples delayed up to 60 seconds are re-indexed by t_device, never t_ingress
source_of_truth: Chronological order of samples within the window

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Record Ledger
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Persist raw telemetry as append-only records with revisions for corrections and backfills.
invariants: Stored raw time-series records are append-only; corrections and backfills append new revisions

assumptions.item: Single subdomain split into three contexts by rule ownership; could collapse into one if team prefers
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Merging would unify the three invariant sets

assumptions.item: Handling of samples later than the 60-second window is unspecified
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: May add a late-arrival policy to Chronology Reconciliation or Ledger

assumptions.item: Downstream event stream broadcasting and its consumers are not described; treated as external
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: May require a separate broadcasting context

assumptions.item: Whether validation precedes or follows reordering is assumed validation first
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Changes event flow between Intake and Reconciliation
